lines.en: I hover and drift along slowly.

lines.zh: 我两米六高，走起来像吊着的灯。
lines.en: Two and a half blocks tall, I glide like a hung lamp.

lines.zh: 双腿垂着，我不怎么用它们。
lines.en: My legs hang; I hardly use them.

lines.zh: 我从树顶上方滑过，枝叶摇。
lines.en: I slide over the treetops and the leaves sway.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，光影在身上跳。
lines.en: I move in stops and starts; light plays over me.

lines.zh: 我身形太瘦，风一吹就摆。
lines.en: I'm so thin the wind swings me.
I drift toward you. Not quickly.

lines.zh: 我绕过塔尖，往下沉一点。
lines.en: I round a spire and sink a little.
I hang in the air and shift sideways.

lines.zh: 我从云影里出来，又进去。
lines.en: I come out of a cloud's shadow and back in.
My hanging hands brush the grass tips.

lines.zh: 我一路飘着，脚下空空的。
lines.en: I drift along with nothing underfoot.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，只有边缘在闪。
lines.en: I hang still, only my edges flickering.
My arms hang like two strings of lights.

lines.zh: 光从我身上一层层剥落。
lines.en: Light peels off me in layers.
I turn my long face slowly.

lines.zh: 我在空中飘，比你高一头。
lines.en: Floating in the air, a head above you.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处，不知道在看什么。
lines.en: I stare into the distance at nothing I can name.
My light dims for an instant.

lines.zh: 我悬在灯下，几乎融进去。
lines.en: I hover by a lamp and nearly merge with it.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候更像影子。
lines.en: Held still, I look more like a shadow.

lines.zh: 风从我的骨架间穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes between my bones.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，我细长的影子在晃。
lines.en: Look up: my thin shadow sways.
I lower my head until my face is close.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的边缘看，会晕。
lines.en: Don't stare at my edges. You'll get dizzy.
I've been watching you a good while.

lines.zh: 你想跑吗？我的手臂很长。
lines.en: Thinking of running? My arms are long.
From midair, I have watched you a long while.
You carry no light. Very dim.
You don't scream. That interests me.
I draw back a little so you can see me.

lines.zh: 你再站一会儿，我就下来。
lines.en: Stand there a while and I'll come down.
My edges scattered for a moment.
I rise a stretch.

lines.zh: 我一会儿近战，一会儿远射。
lines.en: Close range, then far. I switch.
My shape is swaying badly.

lines.zh: 疼我不好说，只是少了一块。
lines.en: Pain's hard to name. I'm simply less.

lines.zh: 我在半空散开，又拼回一条。
lines.en: I scatter midair and pull back into a line.
For a moment I can't raise my hand.

lines.zh: 近了挥，远了射，我一直飘。
lines.en: Close I swing, far I shoot—always drifting.

lines.zh: 我慢慢淡下去，又亮回来。
lines.en: I fade slowly and come back.
Not again. I can't take many.

lines.zh: 你举着灯，我有点被吸引。
lines.en: You're holding a light. It pulls at me.
That glow is like mine.
The long wings fold and I drop a little.

lines.zh: 让我看看那个发光的东西。
lines.en: Let me see that shining thing.
I lack nothing but light.

lines.zh: 举高点，我在上面够不着。
lines.en: Raise it higher; I cannot reach from up here.
My hand is reaching out.

lines.zh: 那光晃得我边缘都在抖。
lines.en: That light makes my edges tremble.
I've drifted slightly off course.

lines.zh: 我落低一点，只到那味道边。
lines.en: I drop lower, just to the smell.
You struck my hanging hand.
I sway and my light scatters.
I rise back and steady myself.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了我飘着的影子。
lines.en: Your hand passed through my drifting shadow.

lines.zh: 别贴我这么近，我看不清你。
lines.en: Not so close. I can't see you properly.
I shift aside a little.

lines.zh: 远了我用气弹，近了我挥爪。
lines.en: Blasts from afar, claws up close.
You knocked my arm askew.
I drift to the other side.
Steady. No more bumping.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，谈不上那些。
lines.en: A shape like mine has no such business.
I'm only a drifting patch of light.
Catch me first.
I'm too tall to get close to you.
Easier to talk up a tree.
Don't embrace me. You'd pass through.

lines.zh: 光聚在一起，也许就是陪伴。
lines.en: Lights gathered together might be company.

lines.zh: 我不睡，所以夜里很清醒。
lines.en: I don't sleep, so I'm wide awake at night.

lines.zh: 你留下，我就照着这片地。
lines.en: If you stay, I'll light this ground.

lines.zh: 我连自己都不太确定是什么。
lines.en: I'm not certain what I am.

lines.zh: 我伸手捡，手却穿过去了。
lines.en: I reach to pick it up and my hand passes through.
I cup it in both hands to hold it.
A little light. Worth keeping.
I lift it to see by.
I reach down slowly for what fell.
This feels heavy in my hand.
I draw the light into my palm.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候，头会碰到树枝。
lines.en: When I bend, my head hits the branches.
I take the brightest one.
Tucked away. Don't let the wind take it.

lines.zh: 你的灯在动，我就看见了你。
lines.en: Your lamp moved, so I saw you.
I bring my face slowly round.

lines.zh: 我悬在你头顶，影子罩住你。
lines.en: I hang above you; my shadow covers you.
I'll fix on you first, then come.

lines.zh: 这地方太空旷，你藏不住。
lines.en: Too open here. You can't hide.
I feel your body's heat.
I drift over, silently.

lines.zh: 停在那个高度，正好打到你。
lines.en: At this height I can reach you.

lines.zh: 你换气的声音，从下面上来。
lines.en: Your breath rises from below.
Good. I've marked you.
Two more steps and I'll begin.
My arms are longer than you think.
Don't look up. It only speeds me.
I counted three. You didn't move.
I'm coming down.

lines.zh: 你终于落单，我从高处来。
lines.en: You are finally alone; I come from above.
I follow above you, slowly.
I hover and turn as you turn.
My light wavers in front of you.
A tree blocks me. I go round.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我降下一尺。
lines.en: Each step you take, I drop a foot.
When you stop, I descend.
At this height, you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 你的影子在往我这边拉。
lines.en: Your shadow is stretching toward me.
I drop below the canopy.
You glanced back, so I stop.
Nearly. Almost there.

lines.zh: 我在空中画圈，等你靠近。
lines.en: I circle in the air, waiting for you.
The edge of my light sweeps your shoulder.
You've backed to a corner. No way out.
I reel the distance in slowly.

lines.zh: 我这条手臂已经伸开了。
lines.en: This arm is already extended.

lines.zh: 你听见风声了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Hear that rushing? That's me.
I pause so you can see it coming.
A little closer. Just like this.
Close enough. I raise my long arm.
One long arm sweeps down.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你肩上，很轻。
lines.en: That landed on your shoulder. Lightly.
The back of my hand is all light.
At range I use light instead.
I extend my arm and strike again.
My strikes are slow, but they reach far.

lines.zh: 你躲开了，仍在我臂展里。
lines.en: You dodged, still inside my reach.

lines.zh: 光从指缝里漏下来，打在你身上。
lines.en: Light leaks between my fingers and hits you.

lines.zh: 这一下不算疼，只是提醒。
lines.en: Not painful, only a reminder.

lines.zh: 我退回半空，重新垂下手臂。
lines.en: I withdraw and let my arm hang again.

lines.zh: 你打在光上，没什么感觉。
lines.en: You struck the light. Nothing to feel.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下袖子，光散开。
lines.en: I flick my sleeve and light scatters.

lines.zh: 这具身体很轻，打人也不重。
lines.en: This body is light, so my blows are light too.
A few more and you'll understand.

lines.zh: 这只手抬起来，另一只也抬。
lines.en: This hand rises, and the other follows.
My long arms retract; I drift back up.
Both my hands come down together.

lines.zh: 这一下扫到了你的靴子。
lines.en: That swept your boots.
I reach down once more from above.

lines.zh: 我的指节擦过你的护甲。
lines.en: My knuckles scrape your armor.

lines.zh: 我在半空亮起来，慢慢显出形状。
lines.en: I light up in midair and slowly take shape.

lines.zh: 这地方光很少，正合我意。
lines.en: Little light here. Suits me.
I sink to just above the canopy.
My edges keep flickering.
I hang with nothing beneath me.

lines.zh: 附近的风把我的光吹散了。
lines.en: The wind scatters my light.

lines.zh: 我在等第一个抬头的人。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the first person to look up.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，很长。
lines.en: My shadow falls long on the ground.

lines.zh: 空中裂开一线，我慢慢成形。
lines.en: A seam opens in the air; I form slowly.
It's very quiet here. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我身上闪了一下，算看见你。
lines.en: A flicker runs through me: I see you.
I'm here. Look up.

lines.zh: 火跟我身上的光搅在一起。
lines.en: Fire mingles with the light I wear.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，光拉成一条线。
lines.en: I drop, my light drawn out in a line.

lines.zh: 水熄了我的光，我一时看不见。
lines.en: Water smothers my light and I go blind.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的形状冲散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my shape.
An arrow passes through my arm.

lines.zh: 那股力量拧住了我的光。
lines.en: That force twists my light.

lines.zh: 没有光可以吸收，我越来越淡。
lines.en: No light to take in. I thin out.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我整个亮成一片。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I flare all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我飞不动。
lines.en: No wind in the void; I cannot fly.
